description: Erection of an outbuilding for storage and use as a gym
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (JSK 001 - Location Plan; JSK 002 - Proposed ground floor plan and elevations Received 28/10/19; JSK 002 - revised plans Received: 28/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Outbuilding to be incidental
The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose shown in the approved drawing or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 7 Sutton Square, and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
